paragraphs: Individual therapy for children, teens, and adults in Groton, Connecticut, offering support with emotional well-being and navigating life’s challenges, including anxiety, depression, life transitions, and trauma.

I’m Jennette! I’m glad you’re here. Life can be messy, overwhelming, and full of unexpected turns, and sometimes we all need a little support along the way. Whether you’re feeling stuck, trying to make sense of things, or simply looking for a place to catch your breath, you don’t have to have all the answers before reaching out. Together, we’ll get to the root of what’s holding you back and work toward meaningful, lasting change.

Individual therapy with children is a supportive and engaging space where children can express their feelings, build coping skills, and work through challenges in ways that feel comfortable to them. Therapy may include play, art, creative activities, and age-appropriate conversations to help children explore their emotions and experiences.

Individual therapy with teens provides a supportive, comfortable space where they can talk openly, explore their emotions, and work through challenges at their own pace. I use conversation, creativity, and activities that fit each teen’s personality and interests to help them build coping skills, confidence, and emotional awareness. My goal is to create a trusting relationship where teens feel heard, respected, and comfortable being themselves.

Individual therapy for adults offers a inviting, supportive space to slow down, work things through, and feel more like yourself again. Life can bring stress, difficult emotions, relationship challenges, and unexpected transitions. Together, we’ll explore what you’re experiencing and find ways to help you feel more grounded, confident, and able to move forward. Therapy is collaborative and tailored to you, your experiences, and what feels most helpful along the way

If meeting from the comfort of home feels like a better fit, or you need the convenience of a more flexible option, secure telehealth sessions are available throughout Connecticut. Whether we meet face-to-face or virtually, you’ll have a welcoming and supportive space where you can feel comfortable, be yourself, and focus on what matters most to you.

I’m a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with over 15 years of experience working with children, adolescents, and adults. I provide a warm, welcoming space where you can feel comfortable being yourself, talk openly, and know that you’ll be met with compassion.

I believe therapy should feel like a place where you can be honest about what’s really going on. You don’t have to have the right words, know exactly what you need, or have everything figured out before you walk through the door. We can start wherever you are.
Jennette provides individual therapy for children, teens, and adults. Parent support is also available. Each person arrives with their own questions and circumstances.

EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) is a therapy approach Jennette provides. EMDR brings attention to difficult experiences while using guided eye movements or another form of alternating stimulation to help reprocess and guide healing.
A welcoming place for LGBTQ+ clients. Jennette’s practice is affirming of LGBTQ+ children, teens and adults. An inclusive, affirming space for LGBTQIA+ individuals of all ages and identities
Reach out with a question or a brief introduction. There’s no appointment calendar here.
